description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to pay grade currencies in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and adds specific properties and constants relevant to pay grade ID filtering and sorting.

classes.name: PayGradeCurrencySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating search filtering options specifically for pay grade currencies, including filtering by payGradeId and predefined sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sorting by 'ct.name'.

methods.name: setPayGradeId
methods.description: Sets the payGradeId filter parameter to the provided integer value.

methods.name: getPayGradeId
methods.description: Retrieves the current payGradeId filter parameter value.
